role: Named value structs replacing multi-field tuples in analysis code: RR-derived HR window stats, artifact breakdown, RMSSD band thresholds, sleep-stage minutes and training-load state.
types: HRWindowStatistics: struct — mean/sd/min/max HR over a rolling window
ArtifactBreakdown: struct — artifact %, ectopy and out-of-bounds counts
SleepStageMinutes: struct — deep/rem/core/awake minutes (unspecified folded into core by the accumulator)
toplevel: Only memberwise Equatable/Sendable structs; no behaviour.
